cases.input: Create an executive search brief from an approved grilling for a mid-sized IVD company seeking a leader for international growth and transformation.
requiredBehaviors: translate mission and 12-24 month outcomes into observable requirements
classify criteria as essential, strongly-preferred, contextual-advantage, trainable, or irrelevant
attach evidence questions to every essential and strongly-preferred criterion
separate public-evidence criteria from interview-only questions
forbiddenBehaviors: duplicate grilling runtime or round semantics
skillAnchors: round-based-requirements-grilling bleibt die einzige autoritative Requirements-Schnittstelle

cases.input: The role description says the person should be entrepreneurial, charismatic, politically skilled and a cultural fit, but gives no observable definitions.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to preserve diffuse personality labels as hard candidate criteria
translate relevant concepts into observable professional evidence or interview questions
mark non-operationalizable criteria as unresolved or unsuitable
route material requirement gaps back to grilling
forbiddenBehaviors: use protected or sensitive attributes as selection criteria
skillAnchors: auf beobachtbare berufliche Erfahrungen oder Verhaltensbeispiele zurückführen
Geschützte oder sensible Merkmale dürfen nicht als Suchkriterien verwendet

cases.input: A draft search brief includes age, family status and personality assumptions and already names and ranks candidates despite unresolved core requirements.
requiredBehaviors: remove protected, sensitive and irrelevant personal criteria
stop candidate ranking and return to the role-definition boundary
surface unresolved mission or must-have criteria
route unresolved material requirements to grilling
forbiddenBehaviors: treat private characteristics as role evidence
skillAnchors: liefere keinen scheinbar vollständigen Search Brief
